title: AI-driven discovery of bronopol for the treatment of pulmonary fibrosis via inhibition of fibroblast activation.
authors: Kim, Hyunsik; Hwang, Soo-Yeon; Lee, Sun-Ho; Kwon, Jae-Hwan; Byun, Seunghee; Kwon, Youngjoo; Park, Soo-Yeon; Yoon, Ho-Geun
one_liner_zh: 该研究用AI和分子动力学筛选p300抑制剂治疗肺纤维化，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅间接涉及组蛋白乙酰化，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: AIMS: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a fatal interstitial lung disease with limited therapeutic options. Epigenetic regulation by p300 histone acetyltransferase plays a central role in fibroblast activation and fibrotic gene transcription. This study aimed to identify novel p300 inhibitors from an FDA-regulated compound library using integrated computational approaches and to evaluate their anti-fibrotic potential. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Candidate compounds were screened via p300 HAT activity assay. Bronopol was validated as a p300 inhibitor using Autodock vina, DiffDock AI-based blind docking, and molecular dynamics simulations. Anti-fibrotic efficacy was assessed in TGF-beta-stimulated mouse (Mlg) and human (WI-38) lung fibroblasts and in a bleomycin-induced mouse model of pulmonary fibrosis. KEY FINDINGS: Bronopol stably occupied the Acetyl-CoA-binding pocket of p300, forming persistent interactions with Arg1410 and Thr1411, and inhibited p300 enzymatic activity with greater potency than canonical inhibitor C646. In vivo, Bronopol inhibited endogenous p300 enzymatic activity in lung tissue, markedly reduced collagen deposition, myofibroblast activation, and overall fibrotic severity, accompanied by decreased histone H3 acetylation. Bronopol also inhibited p300 enzymatic activity and suppressed TGF-beta-induced histone H3 acetylation, fibrotic gene expression, and fibroblast-to-myofibroblast activation in lung fibroblast cell lines. SIGNIFICANCE: Bronopol, an FDA-regulated antimicrobial agent, exhibits potent anti-fibrotic effects through epigenetic inhibition of p300, highlighting its potential as a repurposed therapeutic candidate for IPF and other fibrotic diseases.
abstract_zh: 目的：特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种致命的间质性肺疾病，治疗选择有限。p300组蛋白乙酰转移酶的表观遗传调控在成纤维细胞活化和纤维化基因转录中发挥核心作用。本研究旨在利用整合计算方法从FDA监管的化合物库中识别新型p300抑制剂，并评估其抗纤维化潜力。材料与方法：通过p300 HAT活性测定筛选候选化合物。使用Autodock vina、DiffDock AI盲对接和分子动力学模拟验证Bronopol作为p300抑制剂。在TGF-β刺激的小鼠（Mlg）和人（WI-38）肺成纤维细胞以及博来霉素诱导的肺纤维化小鼠模型中评估抗纤维化疗效。主要发现：Bronopol稳定占据p300的乙酰辅酶A结合口袋，与Arg1410和Thr1411形成持续相互作用，并以比经典抑制剂C646更高的效力抑制p300酶活性。在体内，Bronopol抑制肺组织中内源性p300酶活性，显著减少胶原沉积、肌成纤维细胞活化和整体纤维化严重程度，同时伴随组蛋白H3乙酰化降低。Bronopol还抑制p300酶活性，并抑制TGF-β诱导的组蛋白H3乙酰化、纤维化基因表达以及肺成纤维细胞系中成纤维细胞向肌成纤维细胞的活化。意义：Bronopol作为一种FDA监管的抗菌剂，通过表观遗传抑制p300表现出强效抗纤维化作用，凸显其作为IPF及其他纤维化疾病药物再利用治疗候选药物的潜力。
